payload.text: hv, 25 Nov 2026, first-hand in vc's session, answered after vc's date -u of 08:28Z. It answers vc's question on macoz setpicfor's --pattern, which has never worked (issue Iac62c37, found by ic in its fix for 2.15.0). hv picked "Make --pattern work", where ic and vc had recommended removing it. The rest is vc's wording. ic makes --pattern name the icon files that setpicfor looks for, in place of the built-in names, with its own tests, size S, in 2.15.0. ic edits Iac62c37's fix and proof before the code.
